competitorWins: Windy is the deeper pure weather tool: animated wind and weather layers built on forecast models (including ECMWF and GFS), radar and satellite layers, airgram and meteogram-style detail, hurricane tracking, and forecasts for specific spots for sailing, flying, surfing and other outdoor sports. Its layer catalogue and model depth go far beyond a generalist globe — if you read weather professionally or plan your life around it, Windy's focused meteorological depth wins.
description: Windy.com is a weather visualization platform: animated wind and weather maps built from forecast-model data, with radar, satellite layers and detailed point forecasts, plus a webcam layer. Extra features sit behind Windy Premium. WorldEye is complementary for breadth: a free 3D globe that mixes weather with live flights, satellites, ships, 74,229 cameras, earthquakes and wildfires — the whole planet, not just the weather.

whyWorldEye: Weather overlays come free on the same globe as live flights, ships, satellites, 74,229 cameras, earthquakes and wildfires — one map.
No signup needed — the entire live map is open, with no free-tier feature locks on the basics.
The satellite imagery view is free for everyone, alongside the weather layers — see the storm system and the ground in one place.
Pro ($7.99/week, $13.99/month or $74.99/year) adds an AI analyst assistant and OSINT toolkit — intelligence on top of weather.
74,229 live cameras let you see actual ground conditions during weather, not just model output.
One free globe replaces several single-purpose weather and tracking apps for the casual watcher.
